title: Spectrum of singularities, analytic torsion and Calabi--Yau degenerations
summary: We relate the spectrum of singularities to the geometry of degenerating Calabi--Yau manifolds through holomorphic analytic torsion. We express the leading asymptotic coefficients of the analytic torsion of holomorphic differential forms in terms of Hodge-theoretic invariants of vanishing cycles. For isolated hypersurface singularities, these formulas lead to the formulation of new higher Durfee--Saito conjectures bounding Hodge-filtration dimensions by the Milnor number and Eulerian numbers.
